scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the courtyard drip-filter flush and restore irrigation flow before the afternoon xeriscape planting set-out.
Emerging Need: The filter rinse has begun, but the bowl cap sheds plastic threads and will not reseat, leaving the feed shut off and the same run test unable to continue unaided.
Decision Context: Stored irrigation notes identify the model, no-force rule, and appropriate routine service route; live dispatch notices determine whether same-day help can still be added.
Consequence: After the add-on window closes, the open filter remains isolated past the planting setup and the flush cannot be completed today.

parameter.title: Xeriscape planting set-out
parameter.description: Place new courtyard plants after the drip filter flush and short run test confirm water flow.

parameter.content: I shut the courtyard irrigation feed and have the inline filter bowl off for the drip flush. The mesh is soaking; the studio path is dry.
The mesh is clean, but the lower threads on the filter cap crumbled when I tried to reseat it. The bowl will not catch, so I have the feed still off and cannot finish the run test.

parameter.subject: Monday irrigation route check-in
parameter.body: We have a technician passing residential stops near the north-side acequia corridor today. Non-structural valve-box filter work can be added if the request lands before 10:50 Mountain; after that, the truck is stocked only for scheduled calls. Include the affected line status and whether the filter is already open.

parameter.subject: Monday irrigation route locked
parameter.body: The 10:50 add-on window is closed. New courtyard irrigation service requests submitted now will be assigned to Tuesday or later.
